source_note: Bám năm ảnh Unit 4 trang 38-42 do người dùng cung cấp ngày 2026-11-07. Giữ các câu và mục nhìn rõ làm mốc; câu mở rộng ghi ai-generated. Không nhúng ảnh trang sách.
objectives: Gọi tên địa điểm và tính từ mô tả khu phố.
Đưa ra gợi ý, hỏi đường và chỉ đường.
Dùng tính từ so sánh hơn để so sánh hai nơi.
Nhận biết /ɪ/ và /iː/ nhưng không chấm chất lượng phát âm.

getting_started.title: Lost in the old town!

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: Wow! We're in Hoi An. I'm so excited.

dialogue.speaker: Nick
dialogue.text: Me too. It's so beautiful. Where shall we go first?

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: Well, but Tan Ky House is nearer. Shall we go there first?

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: First, cross the road, and then turn left.

dialogue.speaker: Nick
dialogue.text: Look, there's a girl. Let's ask her.

dialogue.speaker: Phong
dialogue.text: Excuse me? Can you tell us the way to Tan Ky House?

dialogue.speaker: Girl
dialogue.text: Sure. Go straight. Take the second turning on the left, and then turn right.

event_order: Nick, Khang and Phong arrive in Hoi An.
Nick, Khang and Phong decide to go to Tan Ky House.
Nick, Khang and Phong get lost.
Phong asks a girl how to get to Tan Ky House.
The girl shows them the way to Tan Ky House.
directions: take the second turning on the left

chant: There are lots of trees growing.
It's a lively place to live in.
There are lots of places to see.
It's a fantastic place to be.

closer_look_2.letter_context: Ha Noi is beautiful but too busy for Vy. She is having a great time at Cua Lo Beach.
